stops.title: Yu Infɔmeshɔn
stops.caption: Yu kɔntakt infɔmeshɔn.
stops.speech: Yu prɔfayl kip yu kɔntakt infɔmeshɔn, yu om branch, ɛn di rol dɛn we dɛn gi yu akrɔs di chɔch.

stops.title: Yu Sɛtin dɛn
stops.caption: Sikyuriti, notifikeshɔn, langwej.
stops.speech: Sɛtin kɔva yu paswɔd ɛn aw yu de sayn in, wetin notifikeshɔn yu de gɛt, ɛn di langwej we Kairos de tɔk to yu.
